note: Canonical evidence file for 2023. Regulatory claims are phrased as filed allegations or court holdings, not as independent conclusions.

events.title: Ordinal inscriptions open to Bitcoin mainnet users
events.summary: Casey Rodarmor announced on 20 January 2023 that inscriptions were ready for Bitcoin mainnet, after enabling the ord wallet inscribe command earlier that month.
events.significance: Ordinals created a new Bitcoin-native digital-artifact ecosystem and reignited debate over blockspace, fees, NFTs and non-monetary uses of Bitcoin.

sources.title: Casey Rodarmor — How Ordinals Came to Be
Casey Rodarmor — Inscriptions ready for Bitcoin mainnet

events.title: Kraken settles SEC staking-as-a-service charges
events.summary: The SEC charged Kraken entities with failing to register the offer and sale of their US staking-as-a-service program. Without admitting or denying the allegations, the entities agreed to cease the US program and pay $30 million.
events.significance: The settlement became a major US regulatory milestone for centralized staking services and foreshadowed broader 2023 disputes over crypto platforms and securities law.

events.title: Silvergate announces voluntary liquidation
events.summary: Silvergate Capital announced that it would wind down operations and voluntarily liquidate Silvergate Bank, with a plan to repay deposits in full.
events.significance: Silvergate had been one of crypto's most important banking links; its wind-down was the first major shock in the March 2023 US banking crisis affecting crypto companies.

sources.title: Silvergate — intent to wind down and liquidate
Federal Reserve — Silvergate self-liquidation consent order

events.title: Silicon Valley Bank failure triggers USDC depeg
events.summary: After Silicon Valley Bank failed, Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves were held there. USDC temporarily traded below its $1 target before recovering after US authorities protected all SVB depositors.
events.significance: The episode exposed the dependence of fiat-backed stablecoins on traditional banking infrastructure and briefly transmitted a bank failure directly into on-chain money markets.

events.title: Signature Bank is closed by New York regulators
events.summary: New York State regulators closed Signature Bank and appointed the FDIC receiver; the FDIC established Signature Bridge Bank and protected depositors under a systemic-risk exception.
events.significance: Signature's failure, immediately after SVB and Silvergate's wind-down announcement, intensified the banking-access crisis facing US crypto businesses.

events.title: Ethereum Shapella enables staking withdrawals
events.summary: Ethereum activated Shanghai/Capella at epoch 194,048 and block 17,034,870, enabling validators to withdraw staked ETH and rewards.
events.significance: Shapella completed a crucial part of Ethereum's proof-of-stake transition by making staking principal and rewards withdrawable.

events.title: SEC files civil charges against Binance and CZ
events.summary: The SEC filed 13 civil charges against Binance entities and founder Changpeng Zhao, alleging securities-law violations including operating unregistered exchange, broker and clearing functions.
events.significance: The case was one of the most significant US civil regulatory actions ever brought against a global crypto exchange. The allegations must be distinguished from the separate November 2023 criminal guilty pleas.

sources.title: SEC — charges against Binance entities and CZ

events.notes: The SEC later dismissed this civil case with prejudice in 2025 as a policy matter; this 2023 record describes the filing event only.

events.title: SEC files civil charges against Coinbase
events.summary: The SEC charged Coinbase with operating an unregistered securities exchange, broker and clearing agency and also challenged its staking-as-a-service program.
events.significance: The case put the largest US-listed crypto exchange at the center of the national dispute over how existing securities laws apply to crypto platforms.

events.title: BlackRock files registration for iShares Bitcoin Trust
events.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust filed its Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC on 15 June 2023.
events.significance: The world's largest asset manager entering the spot-Bitcoin ETP race changed market expectations and began the sequence that culminated in US spot Bitcoin ETP approvals in January 2024.

sources.title: SEC filing history — iShares Bitcoin Trust Form S-1 dated June 15, 2023
SEC Nasdaq rule-change notice referencing June 15 S-1

events.title: Ripple receives a split summary-judgment ruling in SEC case
events.summary: Judge Analisa Torres held that Ripple's institutional XRP sales constituted unregistered investment-contract transactions, while Ripple's programmatic exchange sales did not, on the record before the court.
events.significance: The split ruling became one of the most consequential US judicial decisions on token distribution and securities law, while leaving important legal questions contested and fact-dependent.

sources.title: SEC v. Ripple Labs — summary judgment text

events.notes: Avoid simplifying this as 'XRP was ruled not a security'; the court analyzed specific transactions and distribution methods.

events.title: PayPal launches PYUSD stablecoin
events.summary: PayPal launched PayPal USD (PYUSD), a Paxos-issued ERC-20 stablecoin backed by dollar deposits, short-term US Treasuries and similar cash equivalents.
events.significance: A global consumer payments company issuing its own public-blockchain stablecoin marked a significant step toward mainstream stablecoin integration.

events.title: Base opens mainnet to everyone
events.summary: Coinbase-incubated Ethereum layer-2 Base opened its mainnet to the public on 9 August 2023 after opening bridging several days earlier.
events.significance: Base brought a major centralized exchange's distribution and developer ecosystem directly into Ethereum's rollup economy without launching a native network token.

sources.title: Base — Onchain Summer and public mainnet opening

events.title: Grayscale wins D.C. Circuit challenge against SEC
events.summary: The D.C. Circuit granted Grayscale's petition and vacated the SEC order rejecting conversion of GBTC, holding that the agency had not adequately explained its different treatment of similar spot and futures Bitcoin ETP proposals.
events.significance: The ruling materially changed the legal landscape for US spot Bitcoin ETP applications and became a direct precursor to the January 2024 approvals.

sources.title: D.C. Circuit opinions — Grayscale Investments v. SEC
Grayscale Investments v. SEC opinion mirror

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is convicted on all seven trial counts
events.summary: A federal jury convicted Sam Bankman-Fried on all seven counts submitted at his 2023 trial arising from the FTX and Alameda fraud case.
events.significance: The verdict closed the central criminal trial spawned by FTX's collapse and became one of the largest financial-fraud convictions associated with the crypto industry.

sources.title: DOJ — Attorney General statement on SBF guilty verdict

events.title: Binance and CZ enter US criminal guilty pleas
events.summary: Binance pleaded guilty to federal charges in a resolution exceeding $4 billion, while founder and CEO Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty to failing to maintain an effective anti-money-laundering program and resigned as CEO.
events.significance: The settlement was one of the largest corporate criminal resolutions in US history and transformed the governance of the world's largest crypto exchange.

sources.title: DOJ — Binance and CEO guilty pleas
DOJ case — United States v. Binance Holdings

events.title: BRC-20 experiment puts fungible tokens on Ordinals
events.summary: Pseudonymous developer domo published the BRC-20 experiment, using Ordinal inscriptions and off-chain indexing to deploy, mint and transfer fungible token balances on Bitcoin.
events.significance: The deliberately experimental standard sparked a wave of Bitcoin token issuance, ORDI trading and blockspace demand, expanding the Ordinals phenomenon beyond collectibles.

events.title: Euler loses about $197 million — then recovers nearly all of it
events.summary: Euler Finance was exploited on 13 March for roughly $197 million. After weeks of on-chain messages, pressure and negotiation, the attacker returned almost all recoverable assets and Euler prepared redemptions for users.
events.significance: The exploit was one of DeFi's largest, but its extraordinary recovery turned it into a rare story where a nine-figure attacker ultimately returned the funds.

sources.title: Euler Finance — War & Peace: Behind the Scenes of Euler's exploit recovery

events.title: Multichain suffers mysterious withdrawals and ceases operations
events.summary: More than $125 million in unauthorized withdrawals hit Multichain in July. The team subsequently said it was ceasing operations after reporting that CEO Zhaojun had been detained in China and access to key infrastructure was lost.
events.significance: The episode combined bridge security, centralized key-control risk and extraordinary organizational uncertainty, becoming one of cross-chain infrastructure's strangest failures.

events.title: friend.tech launches social-token trading on Base
events.summary: friend.tech opened an invite-only beta on Base, letting users buy and sell access 'shares'—later renamed Keys—linked to social profiles and private chats.
events.significance: The app created a short-lived SocialFi frenzy and became one of the first viral consumer applications on the newly launched Base network.

events.title: Jito launches JTO with a major Solana airdrop
events.summary: Jito Foundation opened claims for JTO on 7 December 2023, allocating 100 million JTO—10% of total supply—to a retrospective community airdrop.
events.significance: The airdrop rewarded Solana liquid-staking and MEV participants and became a major symbol of the network's 2023 recovery.

events.title: BONK becomes a symbol of Solana's post-FTX revival
events.summary: BONK was launched to the Solana community on Christmas Day 2022, with half of supply allocated to community distribution. Through 2023, BONK mania became closely associated with a broader revival in Solana usage and culture.
events.significance: Rather than being just another meme coin, BONK became a community symbol for an ecosystem rebuilding after the FTX shock.
events.notes: Launch itself belongs on 25 December 2022; this row captures the 2023 cultural resurgence.

events.title: BONK reward makes the Solana Saga phone sell out
events.summary: The Solana Saga phone sold out in the US after the value of the 30 million BONK tokens claimable by owners rose above the phone's retail price.
events.significance: A struggling crypto smartphone suddenly becoming an arbitrage trade because its bundled meme tokens were worth more than the hardware is one of the most distinctly crypto stories of 2023.

sources.title: The Block — Saga sells out as BONK reward rises
